title: JJUKKUMI Watchman trigger stdin payload v1
description: The bare JSON array of file objects a Watchman trigger delivers on stdin, as frozen by the E0-T5 fixture corpus (docs/integrations/watchman-public-interface-report.md §3-§4). The payload carries no route, resource, or target information of any kind (SRC-003).

name.description: Path relative to the watch root (or relative root). Untrusted input.

size.description: Current size; on delete entries the pre-deletion size. Optional by contract (a trigger definition can omit it from its requested field set); an absent size is accepted as absent evidence. The runtime parser additionally requires the plain integer spelling (1.0 or 1e3 are rejected).

mode.description: Octal mode string (definition-time default field set); the S_IFMT bits carry the type.
